> pi can help you create pi packages. Ask it to bundle your extensions, skills, prompt templates, or themes.

# Pi Packages

Pi packages bundle extensions, skills, prompt templates, and themes so you can share them through npm or git. A package can declare resources in `package.json` under the `pi` key, or use conventional directories.

## Table of Contents

- [Install and Manage](#install-and-ma
…[truncated 8496 chars]…
ited global resources dimmed.

## Scope and Deduplication

Packages can appear in both global and project settings. If the same package appears in both, the project entry wins unless the project entry has `autoload: false`, in which case it is applied as a delta over the global entry. Identity is determined by:

- npm: package name
- git: repository URL without ref
- local: resolved absolute path

## assistant

- **Critical — Windows cross-drive paths are misclassified as project resources.** `path.relative(D:\workspace, C:\Users\...\skill)` returns an absolute path, which passes the current `!startsWith('..')` check. Global skills then receive `project/*` IDs, breaking global enablement and retained overrides. Require a non-absolute relative path and proper `..${sep}` boundary checks. `apps/agent-server/src/resources/resource-catalog.ts:239-245`

- **High — Pi’s configured global directory is ignored.** Discovery obtains `getAgentDir()` but resource roots and extension management hardcode `homedir()/.pi/agent`. With `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` set, Gizmo displays and modifies the wrong installation; Pi Web uses the configured directory while the manager does not. Derive all canonical roots from `getAgentDir()` or an injected agent directory. `apps/agent-server/src/resources/resource-catalog.ts:169-174`, `apps/agent-server/src/resources/resource-paths.ts:24-30`, `apps/agent-server/src/resources/pi-global-resources.ts:13-15`

- **High — Pi Web ignores Gizmo skill enablement and per-project overrides.** The Pi Web branch delegates skill discovery directly to `createAgentSessionServices`, bypassing `ResourceCatalogService.enabledSkillPaths()`. Consequently every Pi-discovered skill loads regardless of the manager switches or project override state. Apply the same catalog-selected paths/no-skills configuration used by the normal branch. `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts:850-877`, `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts:880-905`

- **High — Extension discovery does not match Pi’s extension rules.** Valid Pi extensions using `index.js`, `package.json` `pi.extensions`, or top-level symlinks are omitted, while `.mts/.mjs/.cts/.cjs` files that Pi does not auto-discover are shown as enabled. Global extensions configured through Pi settings/packages are also absent. Reuse Pi’s package/resource resolution rather than maintaining a divergent scanner. `apps/agent-server/src/resources/pi-global-resources.ts:70-96`

- **High — Provider extensions are registered too late in the normal runtime.** Unlike the Pi Web branch, the normal branch loads extensions through a raw `DefaultResourceLoader` and calls `createAgentSession` after initial model runtime creation. Providers supplied by extensions therefore cannot participate in initial model selection; a provider-only setup can start without a model. Use `createAgentSessionServices` or flush pending provider registrations before model selection. `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts:826-828`, `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts:895-939`

- **High — The editor can write outside canonical managed skill folders.** Every catalog path is writable, including skills contributed by bundled Gizmo extensions, and lexical equality does not prevent a catalogued `SKILL.md` symlink from targeting an arbitrary file. Restrict editing to declared canonical skill roots, verify `realpath` containment, and expose an `editable` capability to the client. `apps/agent-server/src/resources/resource-catalog.ts:178-198`, `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts:338-352`, `apps/agent-server/src/resources/pi-global-resources.ts:99-107`

- **High — Invalid Markdown can make a skill impossible to repair in Gizmo.** Saving validates only non-emptiness, closes the dialog, then catalog refresh can drop a skill with malformed frontmatter. Subsequent reads are denied because the path is no longer in the catalog. Validate with Pi’s skill parser before replacing the file and keep the editor open with diagnostics on failure. `apps/agent-server/src/resources/pi-global-resources.ts:57-67`, `apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/AgentStore.svelte.ts:468-477`, `apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/SkillEditor.svelte:36-42`

- **Medium — The global settings page can reuse a workspace-scoped catalog and offer edits the server rejects.** Mounting refreshes only when `store.resources` is absent; a prior workspace catalog remains, project skills receive “Edit Markdown,” but `readSkill()` authorizes against a global-only catalog. Always load the intended global catalog on entry or carry catalog scope through edit requests. `apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/AgentSettings.svelte:25-31`, `apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/SkillList.svelte:63-73`, `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts:338-343`

- **Medium — Skill editing has two data-loss paths.** Writes contain no revision/mtime, so external edits are silently overwritten, and closing through Cancel, Escape, or backdrop has no dirty-state confirmation. Add optimistic concurrency metadata and an unsaved-changes guard. `packages/protocol/src/index.ts:449-457`, `packages/protocol/src/index.ts:1176-1183`, `apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/SkillEditor.svelte:22-43`, `apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/SkillEditor.svelte:46-70`

- **Medium — Wire validation contradicts the declared skill-file schema.** `skillFileSchema` caps content at 1 MB, but WebSocket responses are manually checked only for string types. An oversized file can load into the editor but cannot be written back because request validation enforces the cap. Parse responses with the shared schema and enforce the same read limit server-side. `packages/protocol/src/index.ts:449-455`, `apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/WebSocketAgentClient.ts:426-456`

- **Medium — Resource tests were not migrated with the canonical-folder behavior.** All three discovery tests still assert Gizmo-owned folders and currently fail; there is no coverage for cross-drive Windows paths, custom Pi agent directories, extension manifests, symlinks, or editor path containment. Update and extend these tests before shipping. `apps/agent-server/tests/resources/discover-resources.test.ts:27-117`
